title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Settlement Terms: Notice Credit on TRAC Deficiencies
content:
# Settlement Terms — Credit for Advance Written Notice on a TRAC Deficiency, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Term.** For the deficiency billed on a TRAC unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease whose sale settlement falls short of its book value, the deficiency notice credit is $200 where the written termination notice was received 50 or more days before the turn-in date, $100 where it was received 40 to 49 days before the turn-in date, and nothing where it was received fewer than 40 days before or no termination notice is on the unit.

**Counting.** The days run from the termination notice date on the unit to its turn-in date; days between two dates count the later date but not the earlier one.

| Days from notice date to turn-in date | Deficiency notice credit |
|---|---|
| 50 or more | $200 |
| 40 to 49 | $100 |
| fewer than 40 | nothing |
| no termination notice on the unit | nothing |

## Edges (hypothetical; notice received on day 0)

| Turn-in on | Days | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| day 50 | 50 | $200 |
| day 49 | 49 | $100 |
| day 40 | 40 | $100 |
| day 39 | 39 | nothing |

A TRAC unit recovered after an uncured default, with no termination notice on the unit, receives nothing under this term.
